notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing on Budget Amendment for Fiscal Year 2025-2026
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
ERDA CITY - FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026 BUDGET AMENDMENT
Notice is hereby given that the Erda City Council will hold a public hearing to consider an amendment to the Fiscal Year 2025-2026 Budget.
Date: June 11, 2026
Time: 7:00PM
Location: Erda City Office: 2163 W Erda Way, Erda Ut,
The purpose of the hearing is to receive public comment regarding proposed amendments to the City's budget, including adjustments to revenues and expenditures within various funds.
All interested persons are invited to attend and provide comments. A copy of the proposed budget amendment is available for public inspection at Erda City Hall during regular business hours.

notices.agenda_text:
ERDA
Notice of Public Hearing Regarding Adoption of Erda City Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Budget 


	Notice is hereby given by Erda City a municipal corporation of the state of Utah, located in Tooele County, of a public meeting to adopt Erda's Fiscal Year 2024-2025 Budget on Thursday May 28th, 2026 beginning at 7:00 p.m.  at the Erda City Offices next to the Fire Station on 2163 W Erda Way, Erda UT, 84074. The geographic area that will be affected by the City's Budget is the entire area of Erda.  Further information regarding the Erda City Annual Budget Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and a copy may be obtained from the City Recorder at the address and telephone number set forth below. notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing on Requests to Disconnect from Erda City
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
ERDA CITY PROPOSED DISCONNECTION PETITIONS
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN as required by Utah Code Ann. §10-2-501 that the Erda City Council will hold a public hearing to consider two separate petitions for the disconnection of certain real property from the corporate limits of Erda City.
The public hearing will be held on May 14, 2026, at 7:00 p.m., at the Deseret Peak Complex, 2930 Hwy 112, Tooele, UT, 84074.
In the public hearing, any person may speak and submit documents regarding the disconnection proposal.
Written comments/documents may be submitted to: Jennifer Poole, Erda City Recorder jpoole@erda.gov (435) 243-5577
A copy of the disconnection petition is available for public inspection during regular business hours at the Erda City Fire Station, 2163 W Erda Way, Erda, Utah 84074 and on the Erda City Website at erda.gov
DATED this 20th day of April, 2026.
/s/ Jennifer Poole Erda City Recorder
PUBLISH: __________, 2026
